advantages.title: About us
advantages.desc:
We are a team of enthusiasts united by a shared love of adventure and outdoor activities. Our online store was created to provide you with access to high-quality and functional equipment that will accompany you at every stage of your tourist vacation.

Adventure Pro Gear was born from the desire to make tourism accessible to everyone. We believe that everyone has the right to exciting trips and unforgettable experiences. Our mission is to provide you with excellent and reliable equipment so that you can enjoy every moment of your adventures.

1.title: Quality without compromise
1.desc: We choose only high-quality materials and products that will stand the test of time and extreme conditions.

2.title: Wide selection
2.desc: Here you will find everything you need for any type of trip - from easy camping to extreme mountain climbing.

3.title: Customer focus
3.desc: Your comfort and satisfaction are our priority. We work for you and are always ready to provide advice and support.

1.desc: Adventure Pro Gear is your new adventure and travel store. Our achievements are the result of hard work and a focus on quality. We are proud of our achievements, which testify to our dedication to your needs. New reliable quality, new adventures, new opportunities - all this awaits you at Adventure Pro Gear. Join our community and let us make your adventure dreams a reality.

2.title: Adventure Pro Gear Community

policy.title: User Agreement
policy.description: The following text constitutes an agreement between the online store, whose website is located on the Internet at zzzzzzzz.com.ua, hereinafter referred to as the "Online Store", and the user of the Online Store's services, hereinafter referred to as the "Customer", and defines the terms for purchasing goods through the online store's website.

block1.title: 1. General Provisions
block1.1-1: 1.1. This agreement is a public offer agreement (in accordance with Articles 633, 641 and Chapter 63 of the Civil Code of Ukraine), its terms are identical for all customers regardless of status (individual, legal entity, individual entrepreneur).
block1.1-2: 1.2. By accepting the terms of this agreement, i.e., the public offer of the Online Store, the user becomes a Customer.

block2.title: 2. Terms and Definitions
block2.2-1: 2.1. Product — the list of goods published on the Online Store's website.
block2.2-2: 2.2. Customer — an individual who has reached the age of eighteen, receives information from the Online Store, places orders and purchases Products presented on the Online Store's website for purposes not related to business activities, or a legal entity/individual entrepreneur.
block2.2-3: 2.3. Order — a completed and submitted request by the Customer, addressed to the Online Store, for the purchase and delivery of Products on their behalf and by their instruction.
block2.2-4: 2.4. Website — a collection of pages accessible through a web browser and software modules unified by a single management system, located on the Internet at zzzzzzz.com.ua and containing all the features of a public offer for the sale of Products.
block2.2-5: 2.5. Personal Account — a space on the Website accessible to the Customer, which displays their personal information and history of Orders placed by them.

block3.title: 3. Subject of the Agreement
block3.3-1: 3.1. This agreement defines the procedure for interaction and conditions for the Online Store to provide services to the Customer, based on their aspirations, desires and ability to use services for the sale of Products on behalf of and at the expense of the Customer, their delivery, as well as the Online Store's desire to provide the Customer with information about the Product of interest to the Customer and sell the required Products.
block3.3-2: 3.2. The Online Store provides the Customer with sales and delivery services for Products.
block3.3-3: 3.3. The Customer accepts the terms of this agreement at the moment of placing an Order by clicking the "Place Order" button, which expresses the Customer's confirmation of reading the text of this agreement and agreeing to its terms. Subsequently, any objections from the Customer regarding providing their consent in this manner relieves the Online Store of any liability for non-performance of the terms of this agreement and leaves the Online Store with the right to cancel the Order unilaterally.

block4.title: 4. Website Usage Rules
block4.4-1: 4.1. The Customer may browse the Website content, place orders, and use its other services.
block4.4-2: 4.2. Registration is required for the Customer to access personalized information and gain additional Website functionality.

4-3.text: 4.3. The Customer can register on the website in the following way: complete registration. During registration, the Customer enters the following data:
4-3.name: • First name, last name

block4.4-4: 4.4. The Customer undertakes to provide accurate, precise and complete information about themselves. The Online Store is not responsible for the accuracy and correctness of information provided by the Customer during registration and Order placement.
block4.4-5: 4.5. After registering on the Website, the Customer is granted access to their Personal Account.
block4.4-6: 4.6. The Customer undertakes not to disclose access parameters specified during registration to third parties. If the Customer suspects unauthorized use of such parameters by third parties, the Customer undertakes to immediately notify the Online Store by calling the contact center at the phone number specified on the terraincognita.com.ua website.
block4.4-7: 4.7. The Customer is responsible for any actions performed on the Website under their account and on their behalf.
block4.4-8: 4.8. The Online Store has the right to refuse the Customer use of the Online Store's services if there are grounds to believe that the Customer provided false information, as well as in case of dishonest behavior (for example, violation of the terms of this agreement, etc.).
block4.4-9: 4.9. It is prohibited to use the Website for illegal and prohibited activities. Online Store customers agree to comply with Ukrainian laws and behavioral norms accepted on the Internet, namely, but not limited to, posting materials of extremist, pornographic or other nature on the website that affects and/or restricts the honor, dignity and/or business reputation of third parties and violates generally accepted moral norms, as well as posting advertising information without the Online Store's permission.

block5.title: 5. Order Placement Procedure
block5.5-1: 5.1. The Customer places an Order on the Website independently by adding selected Products to the virtual cart "My Orders" and clicking the "Place Order" button.
block5.5-2: 5.2. All Customers can place Orders for Products, regardless of registration. Orders are processed and delivered throughout Ukraine according to the terms and delivery methods specified in the 'Delivery' section on the terraincognita.com.ua website.
block5.5-3: 5.3. Payment is made: online by bank payment card, cash payment in stores or by card, as well as cash on delivery when the Product is delivered by postal services. Payment is made in the national currency of Ukraine — hryvnias.

block6.title: 6. Payment Procedure
block6.6-1: 6.1. Payment for Products is made directly in stores, by cash or bank card, online payment or cash on delivery. You can also pay on the website through online payment. More information about delivery methods can be found in the 'Payment' section on the zzzzzz.com.ua website.

block7.title: 7. Exchange and Return Terms
block7.7-1: 7.1. Detailed return conditions are described in the 'Exchange and Returns' section on the zzzz.com.ua website.

block8.title: 8. Order Delivery Procedure

8-1.title: 8.1. Delivery Terms:
8-1.8-1-1: 8.1.1. Delivery throughout Ukraine is free with a minimum order amount of 3,000.00 UAH for non-promotional items.
8-1.8-1-2: 8.1.2. When ordering products worth from 1 UAH to 3,000.00 UAH, delivery cost is according to the rates of the carrier 'Nova Poshta'.

block8.8-2: 8.2. The Customer should inquire with the Online Store administration about the possibility of delivery outside Ukraine.
block8.8-3: 8.3. Upon Order delivery, the Customer receives the following documents from the Online Store representative: a cash receipt (or expense invoice) confirming the Customer's payment for the Product and/or Online Store services.
block8.8-4: 8.4. More information about delivery terms and methods can be found in the 'Delivery' section on the zzz.com.ua website.

block9.title: 9. Warranty Obligations
block9.9-1: 9.1. Product quality meets standards, technical specifications, other technical documentation that establishes quality requirements or samples (standards). Product compliance with Ukrainian legislation requirements is confirmed in the manner and procedure provided by current Ukrainian legislation.
block9.9-2: 9.2. The Seller guarantees that it transfers to the Customer the ordered Product of proper quality, suitable for use for the purpose for which such Product is normally used.
block9.9-3: 9.3. The Seller ensures proper use by the Customer of the purchased Product during the warranty period established by Ukrainian regulatory legal acts.
block9.9-4: 9.4. The warranty period begins from the date of sale (the date on which the cash receipt or expense invoice was issued) of the ordered Product to the Customer.

9-5.text: 9.5. If the Customer discovers Product defects during the warranty period, the Customer has the right:
9-5.variant1: 9.5.1. to proportional reduction of the Product price;
9-5.variant2: 9.5.2. to free elimination of Product defects within a reasonable time;
9-5.variant3: 9.5.3. to compensation for expenses for eliminating Product defects.

9-6.text: 9.6. If the Customer discovers significant Product defects during the warranty period, the Customer has the right:
9-6.variant1: 9.6.1. to terminate the Public Agreement and return the money paid for the Product;
9-6.variant2: 9.6.2. to demand replacement of the Product with the same or similar one from those available to the Seller.

block9.9-7: 9.7. The warranty period is extended by the term of the Seller's free elimination of Product defects. The specified term is calculated from the day when the Customer transferred the Product to the Seller for defect elimination.
block9.9-8: 9.8. More information about warranty obligations can be found in the 'Warranty' section on the terraincognita.com.ua website.

block10.title: 10. Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection
block10.10-1: 10.1. When registering on the Website, the Customer provides personal data specified in paragraph 4.3.1. of this agreement.

10-2.text: 10.2. The Customer can register on the website in the following way: complete registration. During registration, the Customer enters the following data:
10-2.info: • information about the Customer's tastes, interests, preferences

block10.10-3: 10.3. By providing personal data on the Website during registration or Order placement, the Customer gives voluntary consent to the processing and use (including transfer) of their personal data without limitation of the validity period of such consent in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" dated June 1, 2010.
block10.10-4: 10.4. The Online Store uses the obtained personal data for the purposes of selling Products and providing services defined by this agreement, for promoting services provided by the Online Store, including through automated processing of personal data.
block10.10-5: 10.5. The Online Store undertakes not to disclose information received from the Customer. Providing information by the Online Store to agents and third parties acting under an agreement with the Online Store, including for fulfilling obligations to the Customer, as well as in cases where disclosure of such information is established by legislative requirements, is not considered a violation.
block10.10-6: 10.6. The Customer is responsible for keeping their personal data up to date. The Online Store is not responsible for poor performance or non-performance of its obligations due to outdated information about the Customer or non-compliance with reality.

block11.title: 11. Information Messages
block11.11-1: 11.1. By registering on the Website or placing an Order without registration, the Customer gives the Online Store consent to receive information messages from the Online Store and its partners acting under an agreement with the Online Store, via short message service (SMS) and email.
block11.11-2: 11.2. At any time, the Customer has the right to refuse receiving such mailings; for this, it is necessary to contact customer support with a request.

block12.title: 12. Rules for Using Materials Posted on the Website
block12.12-1: 12.1. The Website contains materials, trademarks, trade names and other legally protected materials, including but not limited to texts, photographs, graphic images and others.
block12.12-2: 12.2. All Website content is protected by Ukrainian legislation.
block12.12-3: 12.3. The Customer has no right to use materials posted on the Website, such as: making changes, publishing, transferring to third parties, participating in sales or assignment, creating derivative products, etc.

block13.title: 13. Other Terms
block13.13-1: 13.1. This agreement is concluded on the territory of Ukraine and is governed by Ukrainian civil law.
block13.13-2: 13.2. The invalidity of any clause or part of this agreement does not lead to the invalidity of the agreement as a whole.
block13.13-3: 13.3. All disputes arising between the Customer and the Online Store are resolved through negotiations. In case of failure to reach resolution of the disputed issue, the Customer or Online Store may apply to judicial authorities for dispute resolution in accordance with current legislation.
block13.13-4: 13.4. The Online Store has the right to make changes to the text of this agreement at its own discretion at any time and without prior notice to Customers. The current (valid) version of the agreement is always available at zzz.com.ua.

payment_delivery.title: Shipping & Payment
payment_delivery.description1: Once your order is on its way, it’ll reach you by the fastest possible route—hassle-free! That means: our logistics team will process your order lightning-fast. And all of this comes at a fair price with no hidden fees!
payment_delivery.description2: Orders containing special items (such as tents, mountaineering backpacks, pads, poles, sleeping bags, electronics, and liquids) may take longer to ship, as these products are stored separately and packed by hand.

block1.title: Shipping
block1.description: Adventure Pro Gear provides reliable and affordable delivery of your outdoor equipment. We work with leading courier services to ensure convenient delivery straight to your doorstep.

subBlock1.title: Shipping Options:
subBlock1.text1: We offer standard shipping—an ideal choice for those who value reasonable delivery times and affordable rates. Shipping costs are calculated automatically at checkout based on your location.

subBlock2.title: Shipping Costs:
subBlock2.text1: Delivery fees are calculated automatically during checkout. Please review the final amount on the checkout page before completing your purchase for the most accurate shipping cost.
subBlock2.text2: Note that orders over a certain amount may qualify for free shipping. Keep an eye out for our promotions and special offers to take advantage of great deals.
subBlock2.text3: At Adventure Pro Gear, we’re committed to making your shopping experience smooth and enjoyable, with delivery that’s both convenient and cost-effective. Thanks for choosing us for your outdoor adventures!

block2.title: Shipping Damage
block2.description1: Please check your package for completeness and any visible shipping damage immediately upon receipt, and refuse it if you notice any damage.
block2.description2: If that’s not possible, please photograph the damage and keep the box. Contact our team right away at +38-(050)-458-74-74 or email us at adventureprogear@gmail.com. Damage must be documented as soon as possible to preserve your right to compensation.
block2.description3: Failure to file a claim or contact us won’t affect your legal warranty rights. However, it does help us file claims with the shipping provider or insurance company.

block3.title: Payment Methods
block3.description1: When it comes to payments, we aim to make things as simple as possible—no sneaky service charges or hidden fees.
block3.description2: You can pay using your Visa, Mastercard, or Maestro bank card. The amount will be charged when you place your order. Your card provider may require you to verify the transaction after placing the order—just follow the steps shown.
block3.description3: You can also pay via PayPal. If you select this method, you'll be redirected to PayPal during the checkout process. Once completed, you'll return to our store to finalize your order. The payment will be charged through PayPal upon order confirmation.

block4.title: Return & Exchange Policy

description1.text: Your satisfaction with our gear is our top priority. If you're not completely happy with your order, we offer flexible return and exchange options:
description1.subText1: Returns: You have the right to return an item within 30 days of receiving it. The item must be in its original packaging and condition.
description1.subText2: Exchanges: Need a different size or model? Reach out to our support team and we’ll help arrange the exchange.
description1.subText3: Refunds: Your refund will be processed within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.

block4.description2: Please contact our support team to arrange a return or exchange. Note that certain terms and conditions may apply. Our goal is to provide a smooth and secure shopping experience with Adventure Pro Gear!
